summary: Enterprise System Maintenance Bot testing completed. All 3 new maintenance API endpoints working correctly (maintenance-status, maintenance-report/download, maintenance-run). Frontend components (health score badge, download button, PDF download with toast) verified. Bot is running in background with 8 service health checks. All regression tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Health monitor implements 8 service checks with proper async operations
Auto-healer has proper rate limiting (3 retries/hour/service)
Reliability layer implements circuit breaker, retry with backoff, and safe mode
Maintenance bot runs every 5 minutes as asyncio background task
PDF report generator uses reportlab with proper XML escaping (_esc helper)
All endpoints properly protected with admin role requirement
seed_data_creation: None - system_health_checks, maintenance_fixes, reliability_events collections populated by bot
